en.summary: Inspect official version changes for a theme upgrade
details: Inspect changes between official versions, then plan the site upgrade. These examples call native Git through swban base/git.
<official>: absolute checkout path; use swaw/banyan/upgrade/official/ under the system temporary directory.
<old>/<new>: official base/target project tags or commit SHAs; <path>: a file, directory or pathspec in the official repository.
1. Determine <old> (run from the site root):
swban upgrade/version/current  #Report the current theme's official version or commit (old) and source

If old is null or a previous migration is incomplete, review the site in full using the four roots listed below in the official version as the reference. Preserve site content and branding, and report differences in configuration.
2. Prepare the official checkout and versions:
swban base/git clone https://github.com/SwawHQ/banyan.git "<official>"      #Clone the official repository once
swban base/git -C "<official>" fetch origin --tags                          #Update an existing checkout
swban base/git -C "<official>" tag -l "v*" --sort=-version:refname          #List official versions
swban base/git -C "<official>" rev-parse "<old>^{commit}" "<new>^{commit}"  #Resolve the confirmed baseline and target to commit SHAs
3. Check the four site roots:
swban base/git -C "<official>" diff <old> <new> -- hugo.toml                  #Read site configuration changes
swban base/git -C "<official>" diff --name-status <old> <new> -- content/     #List content changes, including subdirectories
swban base/git -C "<official>" diff --name-status <old> <new> -- assets/      #List asset changes, including subdirectories
swban base/git -C "<official>" diff --name-status <old> <new> -- archetypes/  #List content-template changes
4. Explore a directory, using content/ as an example:
swban base/git -C "<official>" diff --name-status <old> <new> -- content/products/  #Narrow the scope to products and its subdirectories
swban base/git -C "<official>" diff <old> <new> -- "<path>"                         #Read changes in a selected file or directory
swban base/git -C "<official>" log --oneline <old>..<new> -- "<path>"               #Read commit messages for that path
5. Filter by path or filename with native Git pathspecs: put these arguments after --; keep the quotes.
":(glob)content/**/_index.md" ":(glob)content/**/index.md"      #Only pages without a language suffix; English in this reference site
":(glob)content/**/_index.*.md" ":(glob)content/**/index.*.md"  #Only pages with a language suffix
With :(glob), **/ matches any directory depth and * does not cross directories. Pathspecs do not support regular expressions.
Start with English pages for shared structure changes. This filter omits CSS/JS, _map.toml and translation-only changes; check those as needed.
Under content/_res/home-art/, review only bundles referenced by home-art shortcodes and their parent _index.md files; unused bundles may be excluded.
Exclude guides, release notes, About and the GitHub entry page as needed. Source differences between the selected versions determine the changes; documentation is a reference.
Append these native Git exclusions after selected directories or globs:
":(exclude)content/articles/docs/**"       #Exclude user and developer guides
":(exclude)content/articles/changelog/**"  #Exclude release-note pages
":(exclude)content/about/**"               #Exclude About pages
":(exclude)content/github/**"              #Exclude the GitHub entry page
6. Upgrade the matching Skill and theme:
Update the complete .agents/skills/swaw-banyan/ from target project tag vX.Y.Z for use with theme vX.Y.Z; changing metadata.version alone does not update the Skill.
swban doctor  #Check theme and Skill pairing after the upgrade
Then build the site. Check the minimum Hugo version, local template overrides and affected features.

zh.summary: 用于主题升级时，检查官方版本的变动细节
details: 先检查官方新旧版本的变动项，再规划本站如何升级。以下通过 swban base/git 调用 Git 原生命令。
<official>：官方副本的绝对路径；可放在系统临时目录的 swaw/banyan/upgrade/official/。
<old>/<new>：官方起始／目标项目标签或提交 SHA；<path>：官方仓库内的文件、目录或路径匹配规则。
1. 确定 <old>（在本站根目录执行）：
swban upgrade/version/current  #输出当前主题对应的官方版本或提交（用作 <old>）及来源
old 为 null 或此前迁移未完成时，应按官方版本下列的四个根项对本站做全量核对（本站内容/品牌应保留，不同的配置项应报告）。
2. 准备官方副本与版本：
swban base/git clone https://github.com/SwawHQ/banyan.git "<official>"      #首次获取官方仓库
swban base/git -C "<official>" fetch origin --tags                          #更新已有副本
swban base/git -C "<official>" tag -l "v*" --sort=-version:refname          #查看官方版本
swban base/git -C "<official>" rev-parse "<old>^{commit}" "<new>^{commit}"  #将已确认的起点和目标解析为提交 SHA
3. 检查四个根项：
swban base/git -C "<official>" diff <old> <new> -- hugo.toml                  #查看站点配置差异
swban base/git -C "<official>" diff --name-status <old> <new> -- content/     #列出内容变动，含子目录
swban base/git -C "<official>" diff --name-status <old> <new> -- assets/      #列出资源变动，含子目录
swban base/git -C "<official>" diff --name-status <old> <new> -- archetypes/  #列出内容模板变动
4. 以 content/ 为例，逐层探索：
swban base/git -C "<official>" diff --name-status <old> <new> -- content/products/  #缩小到产品目录及其子目录
swban base/git -C "<official>" diff <old> <new> -- "<path>"                         #细读所选文件或目录差异
swban base/git -C "<official>" log --oneline <old>..<new> -- "<path>"               #查看该路径的提交说明
5. 按路径或文件名筛选（Git 原生 pathspec）：把以下参数放在 -- 后，保留引号。
":(glob)content/**/_index.md" ":(glob)content/**/index.md"      #只看无语言后缀页面，本参考站为英语
":(glob)content/**/_index.*.md" ":(glob)content/**/index.*.md"  #只看带语言后缀的页面
:(glob) 中，**/ 匹配任意层子目录，* 不跨目录；路径规则不支持正则表达式。
同模块的结构变动可先看英语页；此筛选不含 CSS/JS、_map.toml 和译文特有变动，按需另查。
content/_res/home-art/ 下仅需核对 home-art 短代码实际引用的艺术包及父级 _index.md；未使用的包可排除。
文档、版本记录、关于页和 GitHub 入口页可按需排除。实际变动以所选版本的源码差异为准，文档与版本记录仅供参考。
以下 Git 原生排除规则可追加到已选目录或通配符后：
":(exclude)content/articles/docs/**"       #排除应用与开发文档
":(exclude)content/articles/changelog/**"  #排除版本记录正文
":(exclude)content/about/**"               #排除关于页
":(exclude)content/github/**"              #排除 GitHub 入口页
6. 配套升级与验证：
从目标项目标签 vX.Y.Z 更新完整的 .agents/skills/swaw-banyan/，与主题 vX.Y.Z 配套使用；仅修改 metadata.version 不会升级 Skill。
swban doctor  #升级后检查主题与 Skill 配对
再构建站点，检查最低 Hugo 版本、本地模板覆盖和受影响功能。
